title: VOICE_REQUEST_V1
description: Sent to scholarly-voice-engine (by scholarly-agent or directly by a user turn) describing what writing/revision output is wanted, before any voice-engine-internal context is attached.

input_text.description: Existing manuscript/paragraph text, when task is revise/audit/adapt-to-journal.

research_idea.description: Freeform idea text, when task is draft and no manuscript exists yet.

author_voice_profile_ref.description: Logical id of a SCHOLARLY_PROFILE_V1 (profile_type=author-voice), if calibration is requested.
